words.said: OK, I love it. Let's do it
words.how: Card recommends Weekly recap and Open loops on for testers; page shows the verdict and per-helper reasons with examples.
The point is about a project-work item out of scope, not about helper verdicts on this page.

visual.summary: Desktop and phone screens show a clean single-style verdict page with a punchline box and side-by-side cards; the phone capture shows the layout intact, though the page is text-heavy below the cards.

reader.asked: Choose which helpers testers get switched on first: Recap and loops, Recap only, or none.
reader.note: "The team recommends Recap and loops" and the buttons 'Recap and loops: switch both on for new testers' are clear; but 'Recap only' versus 'None' both leave some helpers on or off in ways the card does not spell out, so a stranger cannot tell whether 'None' turns off Quick index too.
